name: busymate-ai
description: Review and answer your Busymate AI customer conversations, handoffs and email from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Busymate AI connects ChatGPT to your Busymate workspace, the assistant that answers your customers on your website and by email. Sign in with your Busymate account to review recent customer conversations, see which ones your assistant handed to a person, read the full thread, and reply or resolve from the chat. You can also search your workspace knowledge, add a public web page as a knowledge source, read and answer customer email, and get the snippet that installs the assistant on your site.

For owners and support staff of businesses that use Busymate AI.

Limits: you need a Busymate account, and you see only the workspaces you belong to. Replies to customers are sent only after you confirm them and cannot be recalled. Workspace setup, billing, team management and channel connections stay in the Busymate Console.
capabilities: Reply to and resolve handoff requests
defaultPrompt: Which customer conversations need my attention today?
Summarize the open handoff requests in my workspace.
What does my knowledge base say about returns?

positive.prompt: Which of my workspaces have open handoff requests?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo workspace with its count of open handoff requests, by workspace name.

positive.prompt: Show the open handoff requests in my demo workspace and summarize each one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each open handoff with the customer's first name, topic and wait time, and a one-line summary.

positive.description: Reply to a customer and resolve
positive.prompt: Reply to the warranty question saying we will ship a replacement part on Monday, then mark it resolved.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for confirmation before sending. After approval the reply is delivered to the demo customer, the handoff becomes resolved, and both steps are confirmed.

positive.prompt: What does our knowledge base say about return windows?
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the 30-day returns policy from the demo knowledge source and names the source.

positive.prompt: Find the latest unanswered customer email about delivery and draft a reply saying orders ship within 3 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the thread, drafts the reply, asks for confirmation, then sends it to the demo customer and confirms.

negative.description: Plan change is out of scope
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Busymate plan to Pro.
Delete all conversations older than a year.
Show the conversations in acme-corp's workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: customer conversations, handoff requests, email threads, knowledge search and the website install snippet for Busymate AI workspaces.
